ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark-grey and black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the distal 50-70% of both lobes. The left lobe white region is concentrated along the upper half with a feathered transition to dark pigment. The right lobe white region is more extensive, containing internal dark mottling and a distinct dark pigment island near the interior boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 145 degrees and a vertical depth relative to lobe height of roughly 12%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing boundary. High-frequency jagged peaks are visible at the right lobe tip, while the left lobe displays more moderate, spaced-out undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch to acute, slightly elevated tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A prominent cluster of high-contrast brownish and white pixel clusters localized at the extreme tip of the right lobe; sparse white punctate marks are visible in the central dark-pigmented region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized biological colonization forming a textured, protruding mass at the distal tip of the right lobe, likely consisting of sessile barnacles and associated cyamids.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated dark pigment patch (approx. 20x20 pixels) located within the white field of the right lobe distal region.
